description: This PHP class defines a data access object (DAO) for OAuthClient entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to save, retrieve, count, and delete OAuthClient records from the database, utilizing query builder patterns and entity repositories.

classes.name: OAuthClientDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing OAuthClient entities, including CRUD operations and query building with filtering, pagination, and deletion capabilities.

methods.name: saveOAuthClient
methods.description: Persists an OAuthClient entity to the database.

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuthClient entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Returns the count of OAuthClient entities matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity by its client ID.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Deletes OAuthClient entities identified by an array of IDs.

methods.name: getOAuthClientQueryBuildWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for OAuthClient with applied search filters and pagination.
